hook: ChatGPT Plus barah mahine free. Par har kisi ke liye nahi.

beats.narration: ChatGPT Plus barah mahine free. Par har kisi ke liye nahi.
OpenAI ka program hai, ChatGPT for Academic Researchers. India mein applications thirty November se khul rahi hain.
beats.claim: Applications open in India on 30 November 2026 (PTI, via Digit).

beats.narration: Kaun apply kar sakta hai? Research faculty ya postdoc, jinhone pichhle teen saal mein research publish ki ho.
beats.claim: Applicant must be research faculty or postdoc who published research in the last three years.

beats.narration: Sirf chhe fields: Biology, Chemistry aur Materials, Computer Science, Earth Sciences, Engineering, aur Maths aur Physics.
beats.claim: Eligible fields: Biological Sciences, Chemistry and Materials, Computer Science, Earth and Planetary Sciences, Engineering, Mathematics and Physics.

beats.narration: Ek grant mein teen log: ek researcher aur do collaborators.
beats.claim: Each grant covers one researcher and two collaborators.

beats.narration: Total pachaas hazaar naye grants, first come first served. To jaldi karna.
beats.claim: OpenAI will award 50,000 new grants, first-come, first-served.

beats.narration: Kisi professor ya PhD dost ko jaante ho? Ye video unhe bhejo.

title: ChatGPT Plus 12 mahine free, par sirf inke liye
description: OpenAI ka 'ChatGPT for Academic Researchers': research faculty aur postdocs ke liye 12 mahine Plus free, ek grant mein 1 researcher + 2 collaborators. India mein applications 30 Nov 2026 se (PTI ke mutabik). First-come, first-served.
